    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_pop2_wealth_index = 3 } every_scope_pop = { set_pop_wealth = { wealth_distribution = { value = 30 } update_loyalties = yes } } }
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_pop2_wealth_index = 4 } every_scope_pop = { set_pop_wealth = { wealth_distribution = { value = 50 } update_loyalties = yes } } }
}

cmp_pop2_assimilate_state_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_pop2_owner_culture
    owner = { ordered_primary_culture = { position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = cmp_pop2_owner_culture } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:cmp_pop2_owner_culture } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_culture = { target = scope:cmp_pop2_owner_culture value = 1.0 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_cultural_community = scope:cmp_pop2_owner_culture } } add_cultural_community = scope:cmp_pop2_owner_culture } }
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_pop2_owner_culture
}

cmp_pop2_convert_religion_state_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_pop2_owner_country
    owner = { save_scope_as = cmp_pop2_owner_country }
    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:catholic } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:catholic value = 1.0 } } }
    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:protestant } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:protestant value = 1.0 } } }
    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:orthodox } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:orthodox value = 1.0 } } }
    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:oriental_orthodox } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:oriental_orthodox value = 1.0 } } }

    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:mahayana } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:mahayana value = 1.0 } } }

    if = { limit = { scope:cmp_pop2_owner_country = { country_has_state_religion = rel:confucian } } every_scope_pop = { change_pop_religion = { target = rel:confucian value = 1.0 } } }

cmp_pop2_clear_society_modifiers_in_state_effect = {

    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_100
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_500
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_workforce_5
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_workforce_10
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_workforce_20
}

cmp_pop2_preset_industrial_in_state_effect = {
    cmp_staffing_create_cohort_effect = { TYPE = laborers SIZE = 15000 }
    cmp_staffing_create_cohort_effect = { TYPE = machinists SIZE = 5000 }
    cmp_staffing_create_cohort_effect = { TYPE = engineers SIZE = 2500 }
    cmp_staffing_create_cohort_effect = { TYPE = clerks SIZE = 2500 }
}

cmp_pop2_preset_educated_in_state_effect = {
    every_scope_pop = {
        set_pop_literacy = { literacy_rate = 0.90 }
        set_pop_qualifications = { pop_type = clerks qualifications = 1.0 }
        set_pop_qualifications = { pop_type = engineers qualifications = 1.0 }
        set_pop_qualifications = { pop_type = academics qualifications = 1.0 }
    }
}

cmp_pop2_preset_stable_in_state_effect = {
    add_radicals_in_state = { value = -1.0 }
    add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.25 }
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_25
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_50
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_100
    remove_modifier = cmp_pop2_migration_500
    add_modifier = { name = cmp_pop2_migration_25 }
}

cmp_pop2_add_population_effect = {
    remove_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target
    remove_variable = cmp_pop2_feedback
    if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 6 }
        every_scope_state = { limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state } cmp_pop2_spawn_peasants_in_state_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 7 }
        every_scope_state = { limit = { is_incorporated = yes } cmp_pop2_spawn_peasants_in_state_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 8 }
        every_state = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_foreign_state_target } cmp_pop2_spawn_peasants_in_state_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = -2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmp_pop2_feedback = -2 } } set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = -1 } }
    remove_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target
}

    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = -2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = 18 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmp_pop2_feedback = -2 } } set_variable = { name = cmp_pop2_feedback value = -1 } }
    remove_variable = cmp_pop2_any_target
}
